scientific_integrity: The package separates the published search input from the independently replayed arithmetic. It does not represent the source search as a new certificate or claim independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Conditional finite theorem: pair-completeness below 10^4000 is taken from the primary paper's reported computer search and is not independently replayed here. The squarefreeness factorizations and primality certificates are independently exact. The global conjecture remains open.
title: Conditional \(10^{4000}\) verification of the \(\sigma_{2,2}\)-pair squarefreeness conjecture
